verses.1:
A Psalm of David.
 O LORD, hear my prayer.
 In Your faithfulness, give ear to my plea;
 in Your righteousness, answer me.
verses.2:
Do not bring Your servant into judgment,
 for no one alive is righteous before You.
verses.3:
For the enemy has pursued my soul,
 crushing my life to the ground,
 making me dwell in darkness
 like those long since dead.
verses.4:
My spirit grows faint within me;
 my heart is dismayed inside me.
verses.7:
Answer me quickly, O LORD;
 my spirit fails.
 Do not hide Your face from me,
 or I will be like those who descend to the Pit.
verses.8:
Let me hear Your loving devotion in the morning,
 for I have put my trust in You.
 Teach me the way I should walk,
 for to You I lift up my soul.
verses.9:
Deliver me from my enemies, O LORD;
 I flee to You for refuge. + 143:9 LXX and one Hebrew manuscript; most Hebrew manuscripts in You I take cover
verses.10:
Teach me to do Your will,
 for You are my God.
 May Your good Spirit lead me
 on level ground.
verses.11:
For the sake of Your name, O LORD,
 revive me.
 In Your righteousness,
 bring my soul out of trouble.
verses.12:
And in Your loving devotion,
 cut off my enemies.
 Destroy all who afflict me,
 for I am Your servant.

metadata.source: Derived from the Berean Standard Bible (BSB). Missing verses restored from the Textus Receptus tradition for completeness.
